values.alt: Lavender scented candle in a blue and purple mandala tin with its gift box, with size measurements

values.name: Japanese Persimmon

description: A scented candle in a decorative metal tin with a colourful mandala pattern, topped with dried petals. It comes in a matching printed gift box, so it is ready to give or to keep for yourself.
Choose from Lavender, Lime, Rose or Japanese Persimmon. Each candle burns for about 15 hours.
details: Four scents: Lavender, Lime, Rose and Japanese Persimmon
Tin: 6cm wide and 4cm tall, with a lid
One candle per order, in the tin and box shown for the scent you choose. The other designs in the overview photo are not included
Never leave a burning candle unattended, and keep it away from anything that can catch fire

products.name: Acrylic Pen Holder
products.alt: Clear acrylic pen holder with compartments, holding pens, scissors and a ruler
description: Keep your desk tidy and your favourite pens within reach. This clear acrylic pen holder has separate compartments, so pens, scissors, rulers and small desk tools each have a place of their own.
The see-through design lets you spot what you need at a glance, and its clean, simple look suits any desk, study corner or shelf.
details: Separate compartments, plus a low front section for rulers and flat items
Pen holder only: the pens, scissors, ruler, calendar and other items shown in the photos are not included

products.name: Floral Pen Set
products.alt: Five pens with translucent pink and white flower charms and green leaves
description: A set of pens with 0.5mm tips, each topped with a small translucent flower charm.
Soft pink tulips and pale white blossoms with fresh green leaves make a pretty little addition to any desk, pencil case or gift.
details: A translucent flower charm on every pen
Soft pink, white and green flower designs
Pens only, as shown in the photo
